description: Classic Orange Distortion Pedal with Hard Diode Clipping

routingGuide.stimulusOutput: Audio Interface Out 1 -> DS-1 Input (1/4 inch TS)
routingGuide.responseInput: DS-1 Output -> Audio Interface In 1 (1/4 inch TS)
routingGuide.notes: Ensure 9V DC center-negative PSU or fresh 9V battery is connected.
steps: Connect Audio Interface DAC Out 1 to DS-1 INPUT using a 1/4 inch TS cable.
Connect DS-1 OUTPUT to Audio Interface ADC In 1 using a 1/4 inch TS cable.
Ensure 9V DC power supply is connected or 9V battery is fresh.
Step on footswitch to engage effect and verify red CHECK LED is illuminated.
Align physical Tone and Dist pots to 12 o'clock, Level to unity gain.
